title: Google rebrands its Gemini Spark AI agent as Tasks and makes it free in six countries; in the US it can call businesses and buy items with Google Pay (Emma Roth/The Verge)
summary: Emma Roth / The Verge: Google rebrands its Gemini Spark AI agent as Tasks and makes it free in six countries; in the US it can call businesses and buy items with Google Pay — Tasks in Gemini allows the AI agent to call businesses on your behalf, purchase items with Google Pay, and more.
